content.user_title: Manage Gmail with Google Workspace CLI
content.value_statement: Gmail work often requires precise commands for messages, threads, labels, and watches. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the gws Gmail command structure and helper workflows.
actual_capabilities: Routes users to Gmail helper skills for send, triage, reply, reply-all, forward, read, and watch workflows.
Shows the base gws Gmail command shape for resources and methods.
Lists Gmail resource areas, including drafts, labels, messages, settings, threads, and history.
Points users to command help before calling Gmail API methods.
Instructs users to inspect method schemas before building parameters and JSON flags.
Identifies the gws CLI as a required local dependency.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated gws CLI; this file does not configure credentials.
Does not implement Gmail operations directly; it delegates to CLI commands and helper skills.
Does not provide parameter schemas inline; users must inspect commands before execution.
Email access and mailbox changes depend on Google Workspace permissions.

use_cases.title: Triage unread mail
use_cases.description: Summarize unread inbox messages with sender, subject, date, and suggested next action.

use_cases.title: Inspect Gmail methods
use_cases.description: Find Gmail resources and method schemas before building a command with parameters.

use_cases.title: Manage message workflows
use_cases.description: Prepare send, reply, reply-all, forward, read, and watch workflows with clear confirmation points.

prompt_templates.title: Show Gmail options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Gmail skill to show available Gmail resources. Explain which helper fits sending, reading, replying, forwarding, triage, or watching email.

prompt_templates.title: Triage unread inbox
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Gmail triage helper to summarize unread inbox messages. Include sender, subject, date, and suggested next action for each item.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a threaded reply
prompt_templates.scenario: Drafting a response without breaking Gmail threading
prompt_templates.prompt: Read message MESSAGE_ID, then draft a reply using the Gmail reply helper. Keep threading intact and ask before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Plan mailbox watch setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the Gmail watch method schema, then plan required mailbox watch parameters. Explain permission and confirmation needs before execution.

output_examples.input: Show me what I can do with Gmail before sending mail.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies helper workflows for send, triage, reply, reply-all, forward, read, and watch, then recommends schema inspection.

output_examples.input: Summarize unread inbox messages for today.
output: Unread inbox summary with sender, subject, and date for each message.
Suggested next action for each message, such as reply, forward, archive, or ignore.
A request for confirmation before any mailbox change.

output_examples.input: Plan a Gmail watch setup for incoming support mail.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains the watch method, asks for mailbox and notification details, and confirms permissions before any change.

best_practices: Inspect method help and schemas before calling Gmail operations.
Confirm recipients, subject, and body before sending or forwarding email.
Use least-privilege Google Workspace credentials and respect mailbox data boundaries.
anti_patterns: Sending replies or forwards without explicit user approval.
Reusing stale message identifiers after a thread changes.
Treating schema output as permission to access unrelated mailboxes.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides Gmail work through the gws CLI and helper skills for common message and mailbox operations.

faq.question: Does it send email by itself?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare send and reply workflows, but users should confirm message details before execution.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: The skill expects the gws CLI to be installed and authenticated for the target Google Workspace account.

faq.question: Can it read Gmail messages?
faq.answer: Yes, through the referenced read helper and Gmail message resources, subject to account permissions.

faq.question: Does it manage labels and settings?
faq.answer: It lists labels and settings as Gmail resource areas, but users should inspect each method schema first.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive email?
faq.answer: Use it with least-privilege credentials, confirm destructive actions, and avoid exposing message content beyond the task need.
